description: This is a Java interface defining the repository operations for Client entities, including methods to get, create, update, and delete clients.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Interface that declares methods for managing Client entities in the data persistence layer.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object based on the provided client ID.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new Client record in the data store.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes the Client record with the specified client ID.
